defect:
TWO distinct defects that the handoff framed as sharing one step, but they do NOT share one lever:

F-09 [P1, SC-3384] — non-USD partner double-conversion of the discount base. Step 'SyncInputUnitPricefromNet' (AssignmentElement, name=SyncInputUnitPricefromNet, container SyncInputUnitPriceforDiscountBase seq 13, abs lines 117065-117115) copies InputUnitPrice = NetUnitPrice unconditionally (section-0-input1=NetUnitPrice -> section-0-output=InputUnitPrice). InputUnitPrice is the base the later BKM/DecisionMatrix pricing steps price FROM (confirmed consumers: SubscriptionPricing93/99 NetUnitPrice<-InputUnitPrice; AttributeValuePricingUnitPriceMode12/TotalPriceMode22; COLAUpliftonRenewal75; RegionalServicesPrice33). For a non-USD partner line, NetUnitPrice at seq 13 already carries an org-corporate-rate value, so seeding InputUnitPrice from it makes the discount base wrong. Correct source for non-USD is the currency-matched PBE value ListPrice. This IS fixed at this step.

H-01 [P0] — manual line-level AMOUNT discount compounds across identical reprices (20000->15000->10000). This is NOT fixed at SyncInputUnitPricefromNet. Verified: the manual-amount step ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel (actionType=ManualDiscount, AdjustmentType=AmountStringConstant, abs 114592-114684, parent ListContainer60 top-level seq 21) reads its base from its own 'InputUnitPrice' customElement slot whose value=NetUnitPrice (abs 114616-114622) and writes NetUnitPrice back. It does NOT read the InputUnitPrice context variable that SyncInputUnitPricefromNet writes. ALL five ManualDiscount steps read base<-NetUnitPrice, not the InputUnitPrice ctx var. So editing SyncInputUnitPricefromNet cannot make the amount discount idempotent. H-01 needs a SEPARATE NetUnitPrice re-seed-from-ListPrice step placed immediately before the manual-amount discount (inside/adjacent to ListContainer60, ahead of seq 3), mirroring the existing FormulaBasedPricing reset pattern (ResetNettoPrePartnerBase / OneTimeNetSeed / AmendSeedNetUnit).

proposedEdits.why: H-01: THIS is the actual idempotency fix, and it is DISTINCT from the F-09 edit above (they do not share a step). The manual-amount discount reads its base live from NetUnitPrice; on each reprice NetUnitPrice still holds the prior discounted value, so the amount is re-subtracted (20000->15000->10000). This inserts a FormulaBasedPricing re-seed IMMEDIATELY BEFORE ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel (same parent ListContainer60), re-seeding NetUnitPrice from the currency-matched ListPrice so the amount discount always subtracts from a stable list base -> idempotent (20000->15000 every reprice). Uses ListPrice>0 fallback to NetUnitPrice to avoid zeroing lines with no list price. MUST re-number/verify sibling sequenceNumbers in ListContainer60 after insert (this new step takes seq 3; the existing Amount step must move to seq 4, Percentage step to seq 5, etc.) -- do the renumber in the canvas so RLM reindexes cleanly. CAUTION/OPEN: this reset also runs ahead of the percentage line-level discount in the same container; if percentage discounts are meant to stack on the partner-discounted net (not list), scope this reset with an advancedCondition filter child (ManualAdjustmentType = Amount, or ItemDiscountAmount IsNotNull) so it only fires for amount-based lines -- verify against the E-02/partner controls before committing. This edit is offered as the CORRECT-LOCATION H-01 fix; it should be validated in-canvas, not blind-deployed.

fieldsVerified:
CurrencyIsoCode: PRESENT in the V21 block as a context/BKM input parameter (context def occurrences at abs lines 114611-114615 and 114795-114799: name=CurrencyIsoCode, value=CurrencyIsoCode). It is a bindable line-scope field. CAVEAT: every existing *formula* in the V21 block that references currency uses the alias STICurrencyIsoCode (the SalesTransactionItem-scoped alias), e.g. the FX steps at abs 113198/113262/113326 and the CurrencyConversion* formulas. No existing FormulaBasedPricing step references bare 'CurrencyIsoCode'. So while CurrencyIsoCode is defined as a parameter, the currency guard in a FormulaBasedPricing value should very likely use STICurrencyIsoCode to match the proven pattern; this must be confirmed in the canvas formula picker before activating. Both proposed formulas are written with CurrencyIsoCode and flagged to swap to STICurrencyIsoCode if the picker requires it.

ListPrice: PRESENT and used bareword in sibling FormulaBasedPricing formulas (ResetNettoPrePartnerBase abs 116031 uses 'ListPrice'; the Formula Based Pricing at abs 116031 'IF ( PartnerDiscountPercent > 0 , IF ( Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c = true , NetUnitPrice , ListPrice ) , NetUnitPrice )'). Confirmed valid, currency-matched PBE value.

CurrencyConversionNetUnitPrice (the FX step): PRESENT at abs 113190-113253, sequenceNumber=39 -- matches the spec's 'seq ~39'. It multiplies NetUnitPrice by a hardcoded per-ISO rate. It runs AFTER the discount base steps (seq 13) and after all manual/partner discounts (seq 20/21), so a CurrencyIsoCode guard at seq 13 is upstream of FX and expressible. Related FX steps: CurrencyConversionUnitPriceDisplay seq40, CurrencyConversionNetTotalSubtotal seq41, CurrencyConversionTotalLineAmount seq42.
risks:
1. STICurrencyIsoCode vs CurrencyIsoCode: HIGH-LIKELIHOOD adjustment. All working V21 formulas use STICurrencyIsoCode; bare CurrencyIsoCode is only a BKM param name, not proven inside a formula value. If the canvas formula editor does not resolve CurrencyIsoCode, both formulas silently take the ELSE branch (treat every line as non-USD for edit1, as non-amount... etc.) -> regression. MUST verify the exact formula token in-canvas before activating.

2. AssignmentElement->FormulaBasedPricing swap (edit 1): changes stepType/actionType and drops sectionJsonString1/2 + section-0-input1. RLM canvas may not accept an in-place MDAPI stepType change on an existing step name; per memory (ESD multiversion / pricing-proc V21 in-place), MDAPI deploy does NOT reach runtime -- the edit must be reproduced in the CANVAS and activated from Versions. Treat these oldString/newString pairs as the intended shape, then rebuild in-canvas.

3. H-01 sequence renumber (edit 2): inserting a step at seq 3 in ListContainer60 requires bumping the existing Amount(3)->4, Percentage(4)->5 (and any later siblings). If not renumbered, RLM may reject duplicate sequenceNumbers or mis-order. Do the insert+renumber in canvas.

4. H-01 scope over-reach: the re-seed sits in the SAME container as the percentage line-level discount. If percentage discounts are intended to compound on partner-net (not list), an unfiltered reset changes their base. Mitigation: add an advancedCondition filter child scoping the reset to amount-based lines only. This is the single biggest correctness question and must be validated against controls, not assumed.

5. H-01 idempotency depends on ListPrice being the intended stable base for the direct/non-partner amount case. If a line is BOTH partner-discounted AND amount-discounted, re-seeding NetUnitPrice=ListPrice here would wipe the partner discount (which was applied at seq 20, before seq 21). That would break partner+amount stacking. If such stacking is in scope, the reset base must be Pre_Partner_Price__c/Base_Price__c-aware (mirror ResetNettoPrePartnerBase's PartnerDiscountPercent branch) rather than raw ListPrice. Verify whether any control combines partner + manual-amount on one line.

6. Two edits, not one: this explicitly is NOT a single-change fix. F-09 = edit at SyncInputUnitPricefromNet (seq 13). H-01 = NEW reset step before the manual-amount discount (seq 21/ListContainer60). Deploying only the F-09 edit will NOT stop the amount-discount compounding.
